Burpee: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Jump or step your feet back into a high plank, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up to the plank.
Jump or step your feet back to your hands, under your hips.
Explode up into a jump, reaching overhead, and land softly to start the next rep.
Wall_Ball: Stand about an arm's length from a wall, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, elbows inside your knees.
Drive up through your heels and throw the ball up to a target on the wall above head height.
Catch the ball as it comes down, absorbing it straight into the next squat.
Keep your chest up and your core braced through every rep.
Toes_To_Bar: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and shoulders active.
Swing slightly back to build momentum, then drive your legs forward.
Lift both feet up in one motion until your toes touch the bar.
Lower your legs under control, keeping the swing small.
Reset your hang and repeat without losing the grip.
